abstract: OBJECTIVE: We tested whether serum pregnancy-associated major basic protein levels distinguish between benign and malignant trophoblastic disease. STUDY DESIGN: We compared serum pregnancy-associated major basic protein levels in seven patient groups: nonpregnant and pregnant controls, partial moles, complete moles, persistent moles, placental-site trophoblastic tumors, and choriocarcinoma. RESULTS: The results showed that patients with partial and complete moles had elevated serum pregnancy-associated major basic protein levels comparable to normal pregnancy. In contrast, patients with persistent mole, placental-site trophoblastic tumors and choriocarcinoma had low median serum levels comparable to those of the nonpregnant controls. Significant differences were shown between the complete and persistent mole groups (p = 0.0001) and between the complete mole group and the choriocarcinoma group (p = 0.0001); however, persistent moles were indistinguishable from choriocarcinoma (p = 0.2010). CONCLUSION: Serum pregnancy-associated major basic protein levels thus distinguish between benign disorders, such as pregnancy and partial and complete moles, and trophoblastic tumors, such as persistent moles and choriocarcinoma. The absence of elevated serum levels of pregnancy-associated major basic protein may be useful clinically to indicate a more aggressive or frankly malignant tumor.
abstract_ja: 目的：血清中の妊娠関連主要塩基性タンパク(PAMBP)が、良性と悪性の絨毛性疾患を鑑別できるかを検討した。研究デザイン：正常妊娠群と非妊娠対照群、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、持続性奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、絨毛癌の計7群で血清PAMBP値を比較した。結果：部分胞状奇胎と完全胞状奇胎の患者では、正常妊娠と同程度に血清PAMBP値が上昇していた。一方、持続性奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、絨毛癌の患者では、非妊娠対照群と同程度の低い中央値であった。完全胞状奇胎群と持続性奇胎群の間(p=0.0001)、完全胞状奇胎群と絨毛癌群の間(p=0.0001)には有意差があったが、持続性奇胎と絨毛癌は区別できなかった(p=0.2010)。結論：血清PAMBP値は、妊娠や部分・完全胞状奇胎などの良性疾患と、持続性奇胎や絨毛癌などの絨毛性腫瘍を区別できる。血清PAMBP値の上昇がみられないことは、より侵襲性が高い、または明らかに悪性の腫瘍を示唆する可能性があり、臨床的に有用である可能性がある。
